description: GUI for the Windows driver store: list, add, install and delete third-party driver packages, find old unused ones, work with offline images.
notes: Runs as administrator: Windows shows a UAC prompt on every start.
Needs .NET Framework 4.7.2 or newer, which Windows 10 1803+ and Windows 11 already have.
Settings are kept in Rapr.user.config, which is persisted and survives updates.
Do not use the update check in the About box: it would replace Rapr.exe inside the Scoop version folder.
